scope: Illustrative documentation pointers, not a vendor ranking or a claim of equivalent features.

entries.name: OpenAI API
entries.concept: Tool calls and structured application workflows
entries.designImplication: The application must execute a requested tool and distinguish its result from a completed side effect.

entries.name: Claude Platform
entries.designImplication: A tool-use block and a tool result are distinct; app-owned tools run in the application.

entries.name: Gemini API
entries.designImplication: A declared function call returns arguments that application code executes and reports back.

entries.name: Amazon Bedrock
entries.designImplication: A retrieval workflow should be evaluated on a query dataset, not one showcase answer.

entries.name: Microsoft Foundry
entries.designImplication: Separate whether a passage was retrieved from whether an answer is supported by it.

entries.name: Cohere
entries.designImplication: Reranking sorts an existing candidate list; it cannot retrieve a missing passage on its own.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.designImplication: Keep held-out cases distinct from development cases when evaluating changes.
